title: Renovation project management
summary: Manage your home renovation in one app.
whyItFails: One-time use. Few renovations. Tradie adoption. Hard to get them to use apps. Low monetisation. Homeowners won't pay much.

attempts.notes: Home design platform; launched Houzz Pro project tools aimed at professionals rather than homeowners in 2020.

reasons.detail: Tradie adoption: Hard to get them to use apps.
Low monetisation: Homeowners won't pay much.
